title: Story world, arc, episode, scene and manuscript-version graph: ontology and evidence ledger
acceptance: 99 chapter headings not treated as 99 originals
method: Define only the node kinds, label classes, edges and cardinalities that in-repository D07 and vision documents already name, then enumerate what the repository actually contains. Every empirical row and every document claim carries a file:line locator with a verbatim quote. Counts are rows, not artifacts; labels are not nodes; absent sources stay ABSENT.

status_definitions.EVIDENCED: A typed repository record exists at a resolving locator. No row in this ledger reaches EVIDENCED for a story node or manuscript.
status_definitions.LABEL_ONLY: The exact label or title is printed in a repository document, but no typed record, artifact or node exists.
status_definitions.NEEDS_SOURCE: The repository names the family or slot and explicitly records the source, artifact or numbering as missing, pin-only or disputed.
status_definitions.ABSENT: The repository explicitly states the artifact was not imported or does not exist. Absence is recorded, never filled.

node_kinds.definition: A fictional story world: the outermost D07 container. It is not the D10 World/Science domain and carries no observation, simulation or measurement.
A narrative arc inside exactly one world. The ratified D07 id prefix sa_ covers Story Arcs & Episodes; this ledger mints no arc id.
An episode inside exactly one arc. An episode label (for example an NPD token) is not an episode node.
A scene inside exactly one episode: the finest structural node that may carry text. It is not the ORBIT 3D scene and not an NPD page.

One editorial variant of exactly one structural node, with optional derived_from lineage to an earlier variant of the same target. It is not an original, not a D01 edition, and not evidence that any text exists.

label_classes.definition: A numbered editorial index entry. It labels a slot, not a manuscript, edition, version, episode or original. It has no node id and may not be an edge endpoint.
A historical editorial title in the 33-slot XII register. The title existing never means the patch was completed, approved or supernaturally endorsed.
A token printed under "Episodes/tokens" in the vision. It names a lead, not a recovered episode node, page or media manifest.
A cited source family or version reference (XII/XIV). A pin, link or count is a reference, not a manuscript version node.

edge_types.cardinality: 1 world : 0..* arcs; each arc has exactly 1 world
1 arc : 0..* episodes; each episode has exactly 1 arc
1 episode : 0..* scenes; each scene has exactly 1 episode
1 manuscript_version : exactly 1 target; a target may have 0..* versions
0..1 earlier version of the same version_of target; acyclic

cardinality_rules.statement: A world is a root node and has no structural parent.
Every arc has exactly one incoming world_contains_arc edge.
Every episode has exactly one incoming arc_contains_episode edge.
Every scene has exactly one incoming episode_contains_scene edge; a scene without an episode is not a node.
Every manuscript_version has exactly one outgoing version_of edge.
version_derived_from is acyclic and never crosses version_of targets.
Label classes are not node kinds: no edge may start or end at a label class.
Every edge endpoint resolves to an existing node id of the declared kind; dangling edges are rejected.
A heading_label count never determines a manuscript_version, original, episode or arc count.

invariants.statement: A chapter heading is a label. N headings never imply N originals, manuscripts, versions, episodes or arcs; the only permitted derived original count is zero.
heading_label, patch_title_label, episode_label and version_family_ref are label classes, not node kinds, and can never be an edge endpoint.
Every node except a root world has exactly one structural or version parent, and every scene therefore has an episode parent; a parentless scene or version is rejected.
Every node, edge and label row has a resolving repository locator; no world, arc, episode, scene or version is invented, and every edge endpoint exists.
Every declared tally equals the enumerated rows; declared and derived counts cannot drift.
Every quote is a verbatim substring of its cited file at the cited line; quote drift is rejected.
Deriving a manuscript_version or an original from a heading slot, patch slot, book count or synopsis count is forbidden and rejected.
Absent artifacts stay ABSENT or NEEDS_SOURCE with zero instantiated nodes; silence is not filled with invented lore.

forbidden_inferences.statement: heading_label is a manuscript, edition or manuscript_version
chapter sequence == episode or arc sequence
patch title == completed patch or divine completion
book or synopsis count == recovered book, scene or transcript
D07 story world == D10 World/Science domain
D07 editorial variant == D01 source edition or source version
repeated label == same story node or identity

id_policy.note: Only sa_ is a ratified D07 prefix (arcs & episodes). No arc or episode node is minted here, so no sa_ id exists. hd_/pt_/el_/vr_ are ledger-local row ids, not canonical keys. No prefix is invented for world, scene or manuscript_version; those kinds have zero nodes and therefore need no id.

non_claims: No world, arc, episode, scene or manuscript_version node is asserted: all five node kinds have zero instances in this ledger.
The 99 headings are editorial labels, not 99 originals, manuscripts, editions, versions or episodes; no heading creates a node.
The 33 patch titles are historical editorial labels; no patch is claimed completed, approved or divinely endorsed, and slot 014 stays disputed.
No chapter is equated with an episode or an arc, and no NPD token is promoted to an episode or scene node.
No V1-V10 original, V10.1 file, XII registry, BATTERIES book or synopsis is imported, opened, authenticated or quoted.
No D01 edition/source version is created or duplicated inside D07; D01 keeps source version and edition ownership.
No rights, consent or licence determination is made; every row is metadata-only.
No schema, migration, table, API, UI, generator or runtime reader is created; @moonwitness/story remains planned.
No ADR is created or accepted; this is a task design artifact under M17, not an approved architecture decision.
No numeric, phonetic, mystical or label-similarity equivalence is asserted; M17-02 decisions are unaffected.
limitations: D07 Story & Media is a planned domain: packages report @moonwitness/story as Planned and no table exists, so the graph has a schema but no instance data.
The only 99-heading source is one vision document; per-heading manuscripts do not exist in the repository.
Patch titles come from a secondary XV table; the pinned XII registry is absent and patch 014 has two competing titles.
The words world, scene and version are overloaded in this repository (D10 World/Science, ORBIT 3D scene, D01 source version, package versions); the graph fixes only the D07 senses.
No world, arc, episode or scene is named anywhere, so the structural kinds cannot be exercised against real data; the validator exercises them only with fixtures.
The four BATTERIES books and fifteen synopses exist only as counts, so they are not enumerated as rows here rather than given invented ids.
BASELINE DRIFT: baseline_sha is the session-start HEAD; another session may add unrelated commits while this leaf runs, and no cited file is modified by them.
